bsi.editorial_reason: The original Aleppo-pine hypothesis concerns Hebrew 'ets shemen ('oil tree') in 1 Kings 6:23,31-33, Nehemiah 8:15 and Isaiah 41:19; another scholarly identification is wild olive/oleaster. Isaiah 44:14 has the different Hebrew hapax 'oren, whose botanical identification remains disputed (pine, fir, cedar or laurel). It is not source-faithful to treat that verse as an attestation of this particular Aleppo-pine/oil-tree identity. Withdraw only the unrelated key, retaining every old pinned original-word claim and the source edition's own text.
